title: Which K-drama role would you be cast in?
dek: Second lead, chaebol heir, childhood connection, best friend, product placement, amnesiac, noble idiot or rival. Twelve questions about tropes and one shared umbrella.

questions.prompt: Episode 14. The leads are finally happy. You know what that means.

options.label: Someone's about to get a nosebleed
A truck is idling outside
The company is about to collapse
The second lead is at the door

questions.prompt: The contract marriage has one rule: nobody falls in love.

options.label: Add a clause about shared breakfast
Move out. It's the sensible option
Start a rumour to protect them
Break the rule immediately

questions.prompt: One K-drama trope happens to you tomorrow:

options.label: A stranger shields you with their umbrella
You inherit a company you can't run

questions.prompt: The second lead is always the better person.
I cry at the airport scene, every time.
The couple has their first fight in public. Everyone in the café is watching.

options.label: Refill your coffee and observe
Intervene with a tray of drinks
Leave. This is their scene
Film it, for the group chat

questions.prompt: A grand gesture is worth a public apology.
You're cast as a character whose only job is to:

options.label: Look devastated in a nice coat
Be inexplicably rich
Remember something at episode 15
Support the lead, quietly, forever

questions.prompt: The chaebol's mother has invited you to lunch. Alone.

options.label: Wear the outfit that costs more than the lunch
Bring a gift and mention your family
Take the meeting. Take notes
Say you're busy and let them speculate

questions.prompt: I have a cousin I've met once and remember fondly.
A happy ending is a boring ending.
The writer asks how you'd like to leave the story.

options.label: On a train, with a voiceover
Running the company, smiling thinly
In the background, holding the bag
Two years later, umbrella scene

results.name: The Second Lead
results.blurb: You are the one everyone roots for and the plot never rewards. Kind, patient, better-looking in the rain — and somehow always arriving after the other person has already been chosen. You'd be bitter if you weren't so annoyingly gracious about it.
strengths: Loyal past the point of sense
results.watchOut: Waiting to be chosen is not a personality. Say it first, for once.

results.name: The Chaebol Heir
results.blurb: You have presence, a driver and absolutely no idea how a dishwasher works. Your generosity is genuine but arrives with strings attached and a tailored coat. People assume you're cold; really you've just never had to explain yourself.
results.watchOut: Money solves the logistics, not the conversation. Stay for the talking part.

results.name: The Childhood Connection
results.blurb: You remember the exact bench, the exact song and the exact weather. Your affection is built on a shared history nobody else has access to, which is either deeply romantic or slightly unfair depending on the day. You keep the receipts. Literally.
strengths: Fiercely loyal to the original version
results.watchOut: People change. Meet the person in front of you, not the one at fifteen.

results.name: The Best Friend
results.blurb: You're the one holding the bag, making the joke and watching the couple be happy. Your timing is perfect and your own feelings get about eleven minutes of screen time. Everyone leans on you and very few ask how you are.
strengths: Reads the room before anyone speaks
results.watchOut: The supportive role is a choice. Ask for a scene of your own.

results.name: The Product Placement
results.blurb: You're somehow in every scene, holding a branded drink, saying one useful line. You keep the plot moving and you never get the credit. In real life you're the friend who books the table, brings the charger and knows a guy.
strengths: Connects people who need each other
results.watchOut: You're allowed to be the story, not the prop. Take the close-up.

results.name: The Amnesiac
results.tagline: Forgets the plot, keeps the coat
results.blurb: You have lost track of the timeline and you're dressed too well to be questioned about it. Your life runs on vibes, coincidence and the kindness of people who remember things for you. It's chaos, but it's charismatic chaos.
results.watchOut: Other people are keeping the whole story. Write something down.

results.name: The Noble Idiot
results.blurb: You will sacrifice the thing you want for a reason that makes sense only to you. You call it protecting them. Everyone else calls it a horrible decision made with excellent posture. Your love language is a brave, unnecessary goodbye.
strengths: Makes the painful choice look easy
results.watchOut: Ask them what they want before you nobly decide for them.

results.name: The Rival
results.blurb: You arrive with better clothes and a pointed comment, and the plot gets interesting. Your competitiveness is mostly affection in a difficult font. You would absolutely help them win, and you would absolutely make them ask first.
results.watchOut: The sharp line lands harder than you think. Be kind once, unambiguously.
